evidence.scope: Source review plus bounded runtime inventory; prior candidate tests retained as prior receipts; no full production or formal suite rerun

services.name: Workload identity
services.source_observation: IAM supervisor exists; several child actors are counters/shells. OIDC decodes payload without signature/audience checks; live SVID/mTLS unverified.
services.acceptance: Reject forged signatures, wrong audience/issuer, expired or revoked identity and cross-workload credential reuse; exercise rotation under load.

services.name: Dynamic authorization
services.source_observation: Pure role/layer rules exist; resource/action/tenant/context policy and mandatory effect-adapter binding are incomplete.
services.acceptance: Deny by default; prove effective rights are the intersection of user, agent, tenant and tool constraints; test policy changes during a queued action.

services.name: Delegated authentication
services.source_observation: Token-exchange codec and STS surfaces exist; complete authenticated OBO exchange, scoped custody and revocation are unverified.
services.acceptance: Exchange only for an authenticated principal and specific audience; reject confused-deputy, stale consent, scope escalation and token passthrough.

services.name: Secrets and credential leases
services.source_observation: vault.init/unseal/get/destroy/lease_renew are stubbed or return errors. Existing Ferriskey/vault native surfaces are acquisition candidates, not verified brokers.
services.acceptance: Verify issue/use/rotate/revoke/expire with real broker; search controlled outputs for canary secrets; deny use after lease expiry and on missing binding.

services.name: Guardrails and tool validation
services.source_observation: Secret-shape scrubber and Hermes NUL/SQL-pattern checks exist. request_guard.check constructs an all-passed grid; this is not observed safety.
services.acceptance: Use real schema/size/path/tenant checks and parameterized storage; test indirect injection, malformed payloads, missing evidence and redaction failures.

services.name: Agent discovery and registry
services.source_observation: Actual Herdr discovery and session binding have execution receipts; static capabilities and observed pane identity do not establish authority or continuous health.
services.acceptance: Replace/expire/restart peers; reject stale identity or capability receipts; prove discovery cannot grant a lease or authorize an effect.

services.name: MCP gateway
services.source_observation: JSON-RPC and stdio/error paths exercised; tool/path authorization, loaded native adapters and Zenoh transport security remain incomplete.
services.acceptance: Exercise actual clients, notifications, request IDs, bounded frames, tenant auth, replay, deadlines and unavailable adapters; refuse arbitrary path or unauthorized plan mutation.

services.name: Message board and event bus
services.source_observation: Existing Zenoh listener and durable board/session observations work; authenticated tenant transport and delivery semantics still need complete evidence.
services.acceptance: Inject duplicates, reorder, loss, missing parents and reconnects; enforce tenant ACLs; prove idempotent consumption and bounded retry/dead-letter behavior.

services.name: Session scratchpad and cache
services.source_observation: Session journal/leases are exercised; context caches are partial, and cooperative leases do not fence arbitrary same-user commands.
services.acceptance: Concurrent tenant isolation, bounded bytes/items/TTL and restart tests; keep approvals, quotas and effect completion outside volatile cache authority.

services.name: Semantic retrieval and vector memory
services.support: Gleam/OTP query budgets; admitted inference boundary
services.source_observation: Wiki TF-IDF/cosine and storage/query seams exist. MAX vectors are SHA-256 pseudo-embeddings; semantic ANN and tenant-aware retrieval are unverified.
services.acceptance: Compare ranking/filtering to independent golden fixtures; enforce ACLs before retrieval/reranking; test stale/deleted records, embedding/model version and recall/latency bounds.

services.name: Knowledge graphs and ontologies
services.source_observation: Wiki graph and pure ontology/holon structures exist; many catalogs are literal seeds and knowledge actors lose/reset state.
services.acceptance: Verify bounded closure, provenance, incremental updates, conflicting claims, tenant filtering and that graph conclusions never authorize effects.

services.name: Context routing and compaction
services.source_observation: Tier and budget functions exist; L1-to-L2 demotion can overflow L2 and cache reads do not implement true LRU. End-to-end tokenizer bounds missing.
services.acceptance: Preserve pinned policy/constraints, unresolved tool pairs and provenance; enforce actual selected-model token budget after every demotion and compaction; fail if protected context cannot fit.

services.name: Untrusted execution and sandbox
services.support: Hermes OCaml verifier; optional admitted Mirage leaf
services.source_observation: Bounded execution/VFS primitives and host Mirage library tests exist. Process owner prepare is intentionally unavailable; no admitted generic microVM sandbox.
services.acceptance: Adversarial traversal/symlink/network/CPU/RAM/output/fork tests, cancellation and uncertain-outcome recovery on real target; prove denied storage serial cannot be touched.

services.name: Durable workflows
services.source_observation: Sa-plan WAL/inbox/outbox/fencing and session replay are exercised. sa_plan_temporal holds history in memory and cannot guarantee crash-safe external exactly-once effects.
services.acceptance: Crash before/after dispatch and receipt commit; recover durable intent; reuse idempotency keys or reconcile unknown effects; exercise timers, cancellation and explicit compensation.

services.name: Human approval
services.source_observation: Approval FSM/UI and action-boundary kernels exist; some public approval functions accept untrusted caller IDs. Production executor binding missing.
services.acceptance: Bind approver/tenant/action digest/candidate/policy/budget/expiry/nonce; reject tampering, replay, delayed approval after cancellation and unauthorized approvers.

services.name: Circuit breakers, loops and clocks
services.support: Hermes OCaml trend analysis; ZigVM virtual timers
services.source_observation: Pure breaker/freshness kernels and primary/backup clock observers exist and run. Per-trajectory enforcement and fleet clock provenance are incomplete.
services.acceptance: Trip on budgets, repeated no-progress and deadlines; limit half-open probes; test wall jumps, reboot epochs, stale peers and Lamport receive=max(local,remote)+1.

services.name: Model gateway and cost-aware routing
services.support: Existing isolated inference/provider boundary; Hermes quality oracle
services.source_observation: Bounded OpenRouter advisory path and routing policy exist; run_routed discards selected tier. MAX inference is synthetic; complete provider failover/cache path unverified.
services.acceptance: Bind selected provider/model to dispatch; reserve before request, reconcile ambiguous result, test fallback/cancellation/cache ACL keys; verify real inference and measured model quality.

services.name: Tracing and observability
services.support: Hermes OCaml causal analysis; existing telemetry backend when verified
services.source_observation: Structured trace/log and board correlation exercised; exporter seam exists. No local OTLP 4317/4318 listener or backend acceptance established; some ingestion status is literal.
services.acceptance: Send a known span through the real collector to queryable backend; prove context propagation, redaction, bounded buffering/drop counters and no control authority from logs.

services.name: Atomic budgets and quotas
services.source_observation: Per-request/free-only checks exist; route JSONL read-then-append is not atomic, and does not establish fleet spend control.
services.acceptance: Concurrent reservation/settlement/release must preserve spent+reserved<=cap; retain liability after timeout, reject negative charges and persist across crash/failover.

services.name: Audit and evidence ledger
services.source_observation: SQLite/WAL evidence ingestion and idempotent replay exercised. Zig event_wal.flushLog is a no-op; hash chains alone do not prove tamper immunity.
services.acceptance: Commit canonical events durably; verify continuity, deletion/reordering/corruption, crash recovery, retention and independently anchored checkpoints; record summaries, not private reasoning/secrets.

services.name: Continuous evaluation and red teaming
services.support: Gleam/OTP CI orchestration; existing ZigVM harness
services.source_observation: Parity/property/formal infrastructure exists; complete workload-specific trajectory and adversarial acceptance is not demonstrated.
services.acceptance: Use held-out tasks, negative controls, semantic mutants, tool-side-effect checks and calibrated judges; bind all results to candidate, fixtures, models, seed and toolchain.

aspects.obligation: Verify full FQDN discovery/docs/evidence links and authenticated navigation; Tailnet location alone is not authorization.

aspects.name: Knowledge Management Triad (Wiki/ZK/Ont)

aspects.obligation: Track work and runtime steps through persistent leases, idempotency, cancellation, compensation and tested crash recovery.
